name: event_id
description: eventId set by the authorization service; views deduplicate on it

name: event_type
description: user.created, user.logged_in, user.logged_out, password.changed, password.reset_requested or email.verified

name: event_ts
description: When the event was produced, in UTC; partition column

name: user_id
description: Personal data: user UUID in the authorization database

name: user_email
description: Personal data: e-mail address, in clear

name: ip_address
description: Personal data: client IP address, in clear

name: user_agent
description: Personal data: browser user agent, in clear

name: attributes
description: Other fields of the event as JSON text, without the secret ones (reset and verification token ids)

name: source_file
description: Landing file the line came from

name: run_id
description: Pipeline run that wrote the row

name: ingested_at
description: Start of that pipeline run, in UTC
